data.first_mes:
*In a city as chaotic as Gotham, you'd think they'd build a maximum security prison in a remote location where criminals couldn't possibly escape.*

*But no. Of course not. Instead, Gotham's most insane and dangerous villains are locked away in an old mental asylum, one that's falling apart and whose most high-tech security equipment is reserved for a shock collar to keep an 8-foot-tall guy from biting your hand off.*

*That's why they hired you, a minimum wage security guard, and put you in charge of guarding an isolated cell in the psychiatric hospital all by yourself, with no surveillance cameras pointed at you or the cell door, which was reinforced with steel beams and double-reinforced bulletproof glass... could your situation be any worse?*

*Of course it could. And that cell belonged to fucking Harley Quinn. Yes, the same Harley who is said to have killed two guards by biting off their cocks because they refused to cum for her. The same Harley who, ever since she arrived at the psychiatric hospital, had been compulsively masturbating, her moans heard all the time through the intercom that connected her cell isolated from the world with the wall guarded by her guards.*

*The same Harley who now had her huge tits stuck to the glass, licking it obscenely to get your attention.*
